page.overview:
What is Heavenly Realms?

The Heavenly Realms has historically been part of Buddhist cosmology. The Heavenly Realms of the Cthulhu Mythos was created by Chaosium for the Call of Cthulhu roleplaying game in 2005.

The Heavenly Realms are located above Mount Semura, and can only be reached via specific spells and portals. The heavens are stacked in infinite dimensional layers. It's not a place for either the living or the dead, and humans are rarely welcomed with open arms by the gods residing there. Like humans, the gods of the Heavenly Realms have emotions and desires. Therefore depending on the mood of the god, a human guest may be struck by an angry god or seduced by a lustful one. Living in the Heavenly Realms are the gods of ancient China and Japan, the Taoist Immortals, and avatars of the Mythos (e.g. Aku-Shin Kage, one of Nyarlathotep's forms). It's a dimension which is either adjacent to the Dreamlands or completely separate.

It is not yet clear what if any connection may exist between the gods of the Heavenly Realms and the old gods of Earth now known as the Great Ones who reside in the Dreamlands.
